name: Hailey's On It!
description: Hailey Banks is a risk-averse but resourceful teenager on a mission to complete every item on her long list of challenging (and sometimes impractical) tasks in order to save the world.

videos.title: The Beginning of the Friend
videos.overview: On New Year's Eve, 14-year old Hailey decides to make a list of all the big things she wants to do but the real-world challenges she gives herself suddenly have huge stakes when a crazed Professor arrives from the future and tells Hailey the fate of the world depends on her.

videos.title: Beta'd and Hooked
videos.overview: Hailey and Scott set sail to catch the legendary Blue Ono so they can win the top prize at the Fish Taco Festival.

videos.title: The Wild, Wild Mess
videos.overview: After becoming ‘Sheriff for a Day’ at a western reenactment town, Hailey uses her newfound authority to rid the town of an invading dirt bike crew.

videos.title: The Last Sand
videos.overview: Hailey and her dad enter Oceanside’s Sandcastle Building Contest, but a cheating A.C. goads her into a small-scale medieval war of epic proportions.

videos.title: The Show Must Go Wrong
videos.overview: When the star of the school musical injures herself in the middle of the show, Hailey must overcome her fear of performing in front of an audience.

videos.title: Cubix Dudes
videos.overview: When Hailey’s plan to build an owl habitat is derailed, she learns the value of sacrifice for the good of a friend.

videos.title: Cos-Played
videos.overview: When Hailey, Scott and Beta discover that they’ve been scammed at a Hero Force cosplay event, Hailey finds the hero within her to stand up to the bullies.

videos.title: Road Trippin'
videos.overview: Kristine feels like the third wheel after she unexpectedly joins Scott and Hailey on a road trip.

videos.title: Escape Doom
videos.overview: Hailey must lead her friends out of an Egyptian-themed escape room that chaos bots have rigged to crush.

videos.title: The Flamingo Must Flamin-Go
videos.overview: Hailey secretly adopts a smelly, old flamingo and quickly realizes she’s bitten off more than she can chew.

videos.title: Splatter of the Bands
videos.overview: Hailey must decide between perfection and fun in order to win a local music festival.

videos.title: Bringing Home the Beacon
videos.overview: Hailey vows to fix the ill-fated Oceanside Lighthouse before her mom can sell it.

videos.title: Dance Like No Mom Is Watching
videos.overview: When Hailey takes on the list item “Get the Top Score at Mega Dance Hero,” she discovers a breakdancing secret from her mom’s past.

videos.title: Kristine-ceañera
videos.overview: Kristine’s dad takes over her quinceañera and replaces Scott as her waltz partner.

videos.title: The Puffle Kerfuffle
videos.overview: Hailey must reunite an estranged childhood singing duo, but begins to worry about her and Scott’s relationship and future.

videos.title: Flippin' Out
videos.overview: Hailey joins the cheerleading squad when she needs to earn an “easy” varsity letter but quickly realizes she’s underestimated the skill and spirit it takes to cheerlead.

videos.title: Smells Like Queen Spirit
videos.overview: Hailey must defeat a chaos bot that has infiltrated her school while simultaneously winning the school’s Crab Queen Pageant.

videos.title: Catching Felines
videos.overview: Hailey befriends Scott’s little sister, but their friendship is tested by two escaped wild cats.

videos.title: It's All Gonna Be OK-Pop
videos.overview: Hailey races to find her little brothers, Dwayne and Johnson, after she loses them at a K-pop concert.

videos.title: U.F. Whoa!
videos.overview: After a mishap with Hailey’s list, secret government agents nab Beta thinking he’s a U.F.O.

videos.title: Seas the Day
videos.overview: Hailey brings Scott to Catalina Island to get him out of an uncharacteristically mopey funk.

videos.title: Kissed Opportunities
videos.overview: When Hailey throws a party, she sees an opportunity to kiss Scott as part of a harmless game.

videos.title: Sight for Dinosaur Eyes
videos.overview: Hailey ditches Scott at a dinosaur show to build a mystery gadget from The Professor.

videos.title: Along for the Slide
videos.overview: Becker schemes to ride a condemned alpine slide but must endure her school rival, Kennedy.

videos.title: Leather Jacket Hailey
videos.overview: Hailey finds a leather jacket that brings out her rebellious side.

videos.title: In a Pinch
videos.overview: When Hailey gets distracted by her list item instead of babysitting the school mascot, she lands herself in hot water.

videos.title: The Fart of War
videos.overview: When Scott has an awesome idea for a social media filter, A.C. claims the idea as his own.

videos.title: Who Let the Dogs Out? (Hailey)
videos.overview: After Hailey reads an online rumor about Dingles Chips, she, Scott and Beta go to the factory to expose the truth.

videos.title: Beta's Gonna Hate
videos.overview: Beta suspects Alphred, a cleaning robot, is a chaos bot spy, but Hailey and Scott aren’t so sure.

videos.title: The A-maize-ing Maze
videos.overview: Hailey and Beta ditch Scott to complete a complicated corn maze on their own.

videos.title: I Know What You Did Last Slumber
videos.overview: When Hailey's sleepover prank goes awry, she must choose to lie or come clean.

videos.title: Lady and the Trampoline
videos.overview: Hailey faces her fears of trampolining (and sweating in public) in a film noir-style Trampoline Town.

videos.title: Scott's On a Roll
videos.overview: In a competition where the winner has a sandwich named after them, Hailey is pitted against Scott.

videos.title: Bye Bye Birdies
videos.overview: When Hailey must be truthful for a day, she ends up delivering a comedy roast.

videos.title: Frankly Fabulous
videos.overview: Hailey enters Frank into a bird show where they run into his former mean trainer.

videos.title: The Pin Is Mightier than the Swole
videos.overview: Expert bowler Hailey struggles with a list item that requires her to lose to her dad at bowling.

videos.title: We Wish You a Merry Chaos-Mas
videos.overview: When Hailey loses a mini-reindeer, causing Christmas to not exist in the future, she must "Throw the Best Oceanside Christmas Festival Ever" to save all future Christmases.

videos.title: Mer-made in Oceanside
videos.overview: Hailey's attempt to find the Oceanside Mermaid leads to a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Full House (of Bugs)
videos.overview: When the Denogas move in with the Banks family, Hailey and Scott try to speed up the process.

videos.title: The Umpire Strikes Back
videos.overview: Hailey goes to great lengths to catch a foul ball at a Barnacles game.

videos.title: Magician: Impossible
videos.overview: When a popular magician's tricks are exposed, Hailey must find the perpetrator.

videos.title: Bad Bear Day
videos.overview: Scott gets into an exclusive club at school thanks to an amazing hair gel but quickly regrets ignoring the gel's side effects.

videos.title: 2001: A Spouse Odyssey
videos.overview: Hailey throws her parents a dream wedding.

videos.title: The Saw-shank Redemption
videos.overview: Hailey and Scott get thrown into detention.

videos.title: No More Mr. Rice Guy
videos.overview: After Hailey accidentally inspires her dad to go on strike, she struggles to make his famous fried rice for a school event.

videos.title: When Squeeples Attack
videos.overview: Hailey causes an infestation of a wild, futuristic critter.

videos.title: Cool Intentions
videos.overview: Hailey and Scott work at A.C.'s family shop while A.C. shoots a commercial.

videos.title: Out of Body Slam Experience
videos.overview: A hypnotized Scott inadvertently provokes Rowdy Ronnie, who forces Scott to wrestle him.

videos.title: Get Whale Soon
videos.overview: Hailey's attempts to save a whale are interrupted by her talkative next-door neighbors.

videos.title: How Kristine Goat Her Groove Back
videos.overview: Kristine and Hailey go to a local spa where Kristine has a goat-induced revelation.

videos.title: Oceanside's 11
videos.overview: Hailey hides proof of her crush on Scott in a book that the school gossip manages to find.

videos.title: Student of the Weak
videos.overview: Hailey pulls out all the stops to be named Student of the Week.

videos.title: Smother Knows Best
videos.overview: When Hailey and Scott go "Running with the Goats" for a list item, Hailey tries to keep her meddling mom away.

videos.title: The Biggest Luger
videos.overview: Scott receives an invitation to a prestigious luge academy.

videos.title: An Imposter Is Born
videos.overview: Hailey lives the life of her favorite pop star but finds out it's all work and no play.

videos.title: I Wanna Dance with My Buddy
videos.overview: Hailey's plan to tell Scott her feelings at the school dance are thrown into disarray when a compatibility app says they might not be meant for each other.
